title: ORE Valuation Module
description: Valuation method parameters across the income (DCF and direct capitalization), sales comparison, and cost approaches. Each method listed in `methods` must have its parameter object present. The schema carries inputs for all four approaches; reference engine v0.1 computes DCF and direct cap, and carries the others as structured disclosure.

analysisStartDate.description: First day of analysis month 1. Conventionally equals rentRoll.asOfDate; all growth, downtime, and discounting measure from this date.

valueDate.description: Effective date of value, if different from analysisStartDate (e.g. a retrospective or prospective appraisal).

interestAppraised.description: Property interest being valued. leased_fee: subject to in-place leases (the default for income-producing property). fee_simple: unencumbered, all space at market — engines value as if every lease rolled to market terms at the analysis start. leasehold: the tenant's interest.

valuePremise.description: Premise of value. as_stabilized and as_complete values should state their assumed dates and conditions in notes.

purpose.description: Why the valuation was prepared. Recipients weight assumptions differently by purpose.

methods.description: Valuation methods this file carries inputs for. Each listed method's parameter object is required.

purchasePrice.description: Assumed or actual purchase price, USD. Optional: when present, engines report IRR/NPV against it; when absent, engines report concluded value only.

acquisitionCostsPercent.description: Closing costs at acquisition as a percent of purchase price, added to the initial outflow.

holdPeriodYears.description: Hold period in whole years from analysisStartDate. Provide this or holdPeriodMonths, not both.

holdPeriodMonths.description: Hold period in months from analysisStartDate, for partial-year holds (e.g. exit timed to a lease event).

discountRatePercent.description: Annual discount rate applied to unlevered operating cash flows, in percent.

reversionDiscountRatePercent.description: Separate annual discount rate for the reversion, where the shop rates terminal value risk differently. Defaults to discountRatePercent.

discountTiming.description: monthly: end/mid-month cash flows discounted at the equivalent monthly rate ((1+r)^(1/12)-1). annual: end/mid-year aggregated cash flows discounted annually. Declared explicitly so every engine produces the identical NPV.

periodConvention.description: Whether cash flows are discounted as received at period end or mid-period (common in appraisal DCF). The reversion is always discounted from the end of the final period.

terminalValue.description: How the gross reversion value is computed at the end of the hold.

method.description: direct_cap: capitalize terminal NOI per noiBasis at capRatePercent. exit_price_psf: exitPricePerSF × property.physical.buildingSF. fixed_value: the stated fixedValue. grown_purchase_price: purchasePrice compounded at annualAppreciationPercent over the hold (purchasePrice required).

capRatePercent.description: Terminal (reversion) cap rate, in percent. Required when method is direct_cap.

noiBasis.description: NOI capitalized at exit. forwardYear: the 12 months following sale (hold + 1), per the full assumption set. trailingYear: the 12 months preceding sale. stabilizedAtMarket: all space at market rent and structure as of the exit date — a fee-simple-style exit that strips any residual below-market leases out of the terminal NOI.

deductBelowTheLineItems.description: Capitalize NOI net of below-the-line items (conventionally capital reserves). Some buyers cap NOI after reserves; declared so engines agree.

exitPricePerSF.description: Gross exit value per building SF. Required when method is exit_price_psf.

fixedValue.description: Stated gross reversion value, USD. Required when method is fixed_value.

annualAppreciationPercent.description: Annual appreciation applied to purchasePrice. Required when method is grown_purchase_price.

sellingCostsPercent.description: Costs of sale as a percent of gross reversion value, deducted to reach net reversion.

deductUnfundedObligations.description: Deduct outstanding TI/LC and the value of remaining free rent on leases extending past the sale date from the gross reversion — the buyer-assumed-costs adjustment.

noiBasis.description: NOI to capitalize. year1: forward 12 months from analysisStartDate per the full assumption set. inPlace: annualized contractual rent in force at analysisStartDate less annualized expenses, ignoring rollover and lease-up. stabilizedAtMarket: all space leased at market rent and structure — the fee-simple / lease-to-market basis, typically paired with markToMarket and nearTermAdjustments to walk back to leased-fee as-is value. trailing12: not computable from this file alone; provide customNOI alongside. custom: the stated customNOI.

customNOI.description: Stated annual NOI, USD. Required when noiBasis is custom or trailing12.

applyGeneralVacancy.description: Whether marketAssumptions.generalVacancyPercent and creditLossPercent are applied in the basis NOI.

deductBelowTheLineItems.description: Capitalize NOI net of below-the-line items (conventionally capital reserves).

excludeExpenseIds.description: expenseIds excluded from the capped NOI (e.g. an owner-specific expense a buyer would not inherit).

nearTermAdjustments.description: Deduction of near-term costs from the capitalized value — the conventional bridge from a stabilized capped value to an as-is value. Engines compute scheduled costs within the period from the rent roll and market assumptions.

periodMonths.description: Horizon over which near-term costs are deducted, in months from analysisStartDate (e.g. 18).

includeDowntimeLostRent.description: Deduct gross rent (and recoveries) lost to vacancy and downtime within the period.

includeFreeRent.description: Deduct scheduled and modeled free rent within the period.

includeTI.description: Deduct unfunded and modeled tenant improvement costs within the period.

includeLC.description: Deduct unpaid and modeled leasing commissions within the period.

discountRatePercent.description: When present, deductions are taken at present value discounted at this annual rate; when omitted, at face value.

markToMarket.description: Leased-fee adjustment when capping a market-basis NOI: the present value of (contract − market) rent differentials on each lease through its expiration is added to (above-market) or deducted from (below-market) the capitalized value. Presence of this object enables the adjustment.

discountRatePercent.description: Annual rate at which rent differentials are discounted.

adjustments.description: Explicit lump-sum additions or deductions to the capitalized value: deferred maintenance, capital projects, excess land, entitlement value.

amount.description: USD, always positive; type carries the sign.

unitBasis.description: Unit of comparison. building_sf for improved industrial; land_sf or land_acre for land-driven product (e.g. industrial outdoor storage).

concludedValuePerUnit.description: Concluded value per unitBasis unit after reconciling the adjusted comparables.

indicatedValue.description: Concluded value × subject units. Stated explicitly so files are self-checking; engines verify against concludedValuePerUnit.

notes.description: Reconciliation narrative: which comps were weighted and why.

name.description: Identifier or address line for the comp.

pricePerUnit.description: Unadjusted price per the parent unitBasis. Stated for self-checking; derivable from salePrice and size.

capRatePercent.description: Going-in cap rate at sale, if known — supports cap rate extraction for the income approach.

propertyRights.description: Interest conveyed in the comp sale.

financingNotes.description: Non-market financing or other conditions-of-sale color.

adjustments.description: Adjustments to the comp toward the subject, applied in listed order. Use either percent or amount per adjustment, not both.

factor.description: Element of comparison. market_conditions is the time adjustment.

percentAdjustment.description: Signed percent, e.g. -5 adjusts the comp down 5%.

adjustedPricePerUnit.description: Price per unit after adjustments. Stated for self-checking.

amount.description: Land value as if vacant, USD. Provide this or perAcreAmount, not both.

perAcreAmount.description: USD per acre, applied to property.siteAreaAcres.

replacementCostNew.description: Direct cost of improvements, USD. Provide this or replacementCostNewPerSF, not both.

replacementCostNewPerSF.description: USD per building SF, applied to property.physical.buildingSF.

costBasis.description: Replacement (modern equivalent utility) or reproduction (exact replica) cost.

costSource.description: Basis of the cost estimate, e.g. a published cost service and section, or contractor budget.

siteImprovementsCost.description: Paving, fencing, yard lighting, rail spur — site work beyond the building shell, USD.

indirectCostsPercent.description: Soft costs (A&E, permits, financing, lease-up) as a percent of direct costs, if not already in the cost source.

entrepreneurialProfitPercent.description: Developer profit as a percent of total cost.

depreciation.description: Accrued depreciation on the improvements. Percent fields apply to replacement cost new (plus site improvements); the age-life inputs document how physical deterioration was derived.

functionalObsolescencePercent.description: E.g. inadequate clear height or loading for the modern market.

externalObsolescencePercent.description: Value loss from outside the property: market conditions, surrounding uses.

economicLifeYears.description: Total economic life used in the age-life calculation.

indicatedValue.description: Land + depreciated improvements (+ profit). Stated for self-checking; engines verify against components.

reconciliation.description: Final value conclusion across the approaches carried in this file.

exposureTimeMonths.description: Estimated exposure time supporting the conclusion (appraisal context).

notes.description: Reconciliation narrative: weighting rationale across approaches.
